tldr.en: Encode proprioceptive history into a latent source and transport it toward future actions instead of starting from Gaussian noise.
tldr.zh: 将本体动作历史编码为潜在生成起点，向未来动作迁移，替代从高斯噪声开始的生成。

evaluation_scope.en: Visuomotor policy and temporal-generation experiments; not established here as a plug-in π0.5 accelerator. Detailed timing protocol remains to be extracted.
evaluation_scope.zh: 视觉运动策略与时序生成实验；本次证据不能将其写成即插即用的 π0.5 加速器。具体计时口径待进一步摘录。
